description: Synthetic ranking fixture for memory_search (task #1913). Invented notes and queries; no user or production memory. Frozen: change by adding a new version.

notes.title: SQLite WAL checkpoint starvation on the hub
notes.content: memory.db grew to 4 GB because a long-lived reader connection in the web UI kept the write-ahead log from checkpointing. Fix: close the dashboard cursor after each poll and run PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE) nightly.

notes.title: Tailscale MagicDNS stopped resolving on the laptop
notes.content: After a macOS update the laptop could not reach the hub by hostname: the MagicDNS resolver was disabled. Register the MCP server with the raw tailnet IP 100.64.0.10 instead of the hostname.

notes.title: Codex CLI ignores the env table for stdio MCP children
notes.content: Codex does not pass the env block from config.toml to stdio MCP servers, so UA_AGENT_TOKEN never arrived and every call was unauthenticated. Export the bearer token in the shell profile before launching codex.

notes.title: fastembed model fetch fails behind a captive portal
notes.content: On hotel wifi the ONNX model download from Hugging Face returned an HTML login page and fastembed raised a protobuf decode error. Prefetch the model at home; the embedding-marked pytest tier then skips with 'embedding model unavailable'.

notes.title: Ruff is not on PATH on the Linux desktop desktop
notes.content: mise does not shim ruff globally. Use ~/dev/unified_agent/.venv/bin/ruff or uvx ruff for lint and format.

notes.title: Task #1234 rate limiter design
notes.content: Token bucket per agent label: 60 requests per minute with a burst of 20. Buckets live in process memory and reset when the hub restarts.

notes.title: Follow-up: persist the request buckets
notes.content: For task #1234 the token buckets now persist to SQLite so a restart no longer hands every agent a fresh burst.

notes.title: Rebase conflict on task/1702-vault-sync
notes.content: Rebasing task/1702-vault-sync onto main conflicted in sync.py because #1690 renamed the snapshot helpers. Resolved by keeping the new names and re-running test_sync.py.

notes.title: Executor daemon wedges after the Mac sleeps
notes.content: The headless executor stops claiming dispatches after the lid is closed overnight. launchd does not restart it because the process is alive while its asyncio loop waits on a dead socket. Workaround: KeepAlive plus a five-minute watchdog ping.

notes.title: Obsidian Sync conflicted copies of daily notes
notes.content: Two machines creating Logs/YYYY-MM-DD.md at midnight produced 'conflicted copy' files. Only the hub writes the daily journal note now.

notes.title: Approval queue is hub configuration
notes.content: UA_APPROVAL_TOOLS is empty unless set in service.env on the hub. Agents cannot opt in or out; only the operator edits it.

notes.title: pytest-xdist makes state-sync tests flaky
notes.content: Running with -n auto broke test_sync.py intermittently because state snapshots shared one vault tmpdir across workers. The sync tests stay in a serial shard.

notes.title: GitHub Actions runs only with the ci:full label
notes.content: Ordinary pushes to a PR run nothing. Add the ci:full label or dispatch the batch verification workflow to get a full run.

notes.title: Depot uv cache key collision
notes.content: Two workflows shared one uv cache key and restored a venv built for Python 3.12 into a 3.13 job. The key now includes the interpreter version.

notes.title: server_agent5 ran out of disk
notes.content: journald logs filled /var on server_agent5. Set SystemMaxUse=500M in journald.conf and vacuum to 200M.

notes.title: Cursor ignores .cursorrules
notes.content: Since 0.45 Cursor reads .cursor/rules/*.mdc files; the legacy .cursorrules file is silently skipped.

notes.title: Antigravity MCP entry needs serverUrl
notes.content: Antigravity's mcp_config.json requires serverUrl. url or httpUrl silently disables the server entry.

notes.title: Antigravity post-write hook runs ruff
notes.content: Antigravity hooks in .agents/hooks.json call scripts/hook_post_write.py, which runs ruff fix after each write, and hook_pre_push.py before git push.

notes.title: bge-small cosine scores for unrelated text
notes.content: bge-small-en-v1.5 gives cosine 0.55 to 0.60 between unrelated short texts, so that range is not evidence of a semantic match. Real paraphrases score higher.

notes.title: memory_fts tokenizer stems words
notes.content: memory_fts uses tokenize='porter unicode61', so 'deploying' matches 'deploy' and 'notes' matches 'note'.

notes.title: Web UI sign-in loop on Safari
notes.content: Safari drops the SameSite=Strict session cookie on the redirect from the tailnet IP, so the control center keeps showing the login page on iPhone. Use SameSite=Lax.

notes.title: Stripe webhook secret rotation
notes.content: Rotate the webhook signing secret in two phases: add the new secret, deploy, then remove the old one after an hour of clean deliveries.

notes.title: Laptop_Agent2 bearer token expired
notes.content: Per-agent bearer tokens expire after 90 days. Laptop_Agent2 started getting 401s; regenerate with unified-agent-token issue Laptop_Agent2 and update its config.

notes.title: PR #1588 reverted
notes.content: PR #1588 (vectorized memory scan) was reverted because sqlite-vec was missing from the hub build; it re-landed as #1601 with a UDF fallback.

notes.title: uv lock drift fails CI
notes.content: uv sync --locked fails when pyproject.toml changed without uv lock. Run uv lock and commit uv.lock alongside the dependency change.

notes.title: Tool list is cached at connect
notes.content: A hub restart does not refresh a live session's tool list. After a tool change deploys, reconnect the host before assuming the tool exists.

notes.title: Gemini free tier returns 429
notes.content: gemini_ask hits HTTP 429 after about 50 requests a day on a free AI Studio key; the llm_client falls back to the next provider.

notes.title: Review cron schedule
notes.content: deploy/systemd/ua-review.timer fires every 15 minutes; read its logs with journalctl -u ua-review.

notes.title: Shared stash stack across worktrees
notes.content: All worktrees share one git stash stack. A bare git stash pop in one worktree restored another agent's half-finished changes. Use WIP commits instead.

notes.title: Vault write directories
notes.content: UA_VAULT_WRITE_DIRS defaults to 00 - Inbox, Logs and Wiki; resolve_in_vault refuses writes anywhere else.

notes.title: Prism thumbnails moved to libvips
notes.content: Thumbnail generation switched from Pillow to pyvips: six times faster and half the memory on large TIFF uploads.

notes.title: Orbit APNs uses a .p8 auth key
notes.content: Orbit push notifications authenticate with an APNs .p8 auth key instead of a yearly certificate. The key id lives in 1Password.

notes.title: Atlas Postgres connection pool exhaustion
notes.content: Atlas ran out of Postgres connections at peak. Fix: pgbouncer in transaction mode, SQLAlchemy pool_size 5, max_client_conn 200.

notes.title: Harbor docker image slimmed
notes.content: A multi-stage build cut the harbor image from 1.2 GB to 180 MB using python:3.13-slim and uv export.

notes.title: task_update doing does not take the claim lock
notes.content: task_update(status='doing') leaves claimed_by empty; only task_claim takes the lock. Never use either to clear another agent's claim.

notes.title: Broadcast tag is human-only
notes.content: Saving a note tagged broadcast, or with salience above 0.8, requires the verified human operator identity. Agents get a ToolError.

notes.title: run_cmd has no shell
notes.content: run_cmd executes allowlisted programs directly without a shell: pipes, redirects and globbing do not work. Run long builds on the host.

notes.title: Juniper feature flags via Unleash
notes.content: Juniper toggles features through a self-hosted Unleash server; flags default off in staging.

notes.title: Summit nightly backup to B2
notes.content: Summit's Postgres dump is uploaded to Backblaze B2 at 03:00 UTC with restic; retention keeps 30 dailies.

notes.title: Ledger invoice PDF fonts
notes.content: WeasyPrint rendered invoice PDFs with fallback fonts until Inter was installed in the container image.

notes.title: Hook blocks commands that print secrets
notes.content: The PreToolUse Bash hook rejects env, printenv and cat of .env files. Check a variable by length and prefix only.

notes.title: Embedding backfill runs in the background
notes.content: memory_semantic.backfill_memory_embeddings embeds notes saved while the model was unavailable; it runs in bounded batches after startup.

notes.title: sqlite-vec missing on the Mac hub
notes.content: The Homebrew Python on the Mac was built without loadable extension support, so sqlite-vec never loaded and search used the UDF scan.

notes.title: Session packet memory injection cap
notes.content: Automatic memory injection into session packets is capped at five items and a token budget; explicit memory_search is not capped that way.

notes.title: Quartz export job timezone bug
notes.content: The Quartz nightly export used local time and skipped an hour at the DST change; it now schedules in UTC.

notes.title: Beacon map tiles from Protomaps
notes.content: Beacon serves vector map tiles from a single Protomaps PMTiles file on R2 instead of a tile server.

notes.title: MCP inspector for local debugging
notes.content: uv run mcp dev src/unified_agent/server.py opens the interactive MCP inspector against a local stdio server.

notes.title: Branch fix/webui-csp-nonce
notes.content: fix/webui-csp-nonce adds a per-request nonce to the control center's Content-Security-Policy so inline scripts stop being blocked.

notes.title: Task #1777 hub disk alert
notes.content: Task #1777 adds a system_doctor warning when the hub volume is above 90 percent full.

notes.title: Desktop_Agent4 workspace root
notes.content: Desktop_Agent4 is rooted at ~/agent-workspace, so hub fs_write cannot reach other checkouts; it uses its own editor tools there.

notes.title: Hub listens on port 8080
notes.content: The unified-agent hub HTTP transport listens on port 8080.

notes.title: Hub listens on port 8765
notes.content: The unified-agent hub HTTP transport moved to port 8765 at http://100.64.0.10:8765/mcp.

notes.title: Review cron merges green PRs
notes.content: The review cron merges a pull request automatically once CI is green.

notes.title: Reviewer validates and holds
notes.content: reviewer.py validates and holds pull requests; it never merges. Merges are batched by a hub-connected agent.

notes.title: Embedding model is all-MiniLM-L6-v2
notes.content: memory embeddings use sentence-transformers all-MiniLM-L6-v2.

notes.title: Embedding model is bge-small-en-v1.5
notes.content: memory embeddings now use BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 through fastembed (384 dimensions).

notes.title: Desktop keeps a local memory database
notes.content: The Linux desktop desktop runs its own memory.db and syncs to the hub nightly.

notes.title: Desktop never runs a hub
notes.content: The Linux desktop desktop is a client only: NO_LOCAL_MEMORY_DB makes storage.connect refuse to create a memory database there.

notes.title: Quarterly focus: vault ingest
notes.content: This quarter's engineering focus is the vault ingest pipeline and Wiki lint.

notes.title: Quarterly focus: memory retrieval quality
notes.content: This quarter's engineering focus is memory retrieval quality and evaluation.

notes.title: Desktop Python version 3.12
notes.content: The desktop venvs are built with Python 3.12.

notes.title: Desktop moved to Python 3.13
notes.content: The desktop venvs are now built with Python 3.13 after the mise upgrade.

notes.title: On-call rotation (old)
notes.content: On-call rotation: Operator covers weekday alerts and nobody covers nights.

notes.title: On-call rotation: Hermes handles nights
notes.content: On-call rotation: server_agent5 triages overnight alerts and pages Operator only for red-tier incidents.

notes.title: Release checklist v1
notes.content: Release checklist: bump version, tag, write changelog by hand.

notes.title: Release checklist v2
notes.content: Release checklist: assemble changelog.d fragments, bump version, tag, deploy the hub, close evidence.

notes.title: Session start checklist
notes.content: At session start run profile_status, then task_list for your queue, then memory_search for the project. Check broadcasts. Claim a task before editing anything.

notes.title: Fleet rules summary
notes.content: Never print secrets. Verify before you assert. Targeted tests only. Test first. Branch, commit as your label, open a PR, do not merge without review.

notes.title: Memory note conventions
notes.content: Pass author on every memory_save and tag it with project plus pref, fact or decision. Prefer append over overwrite for another author's note.

notes.title: How to ship a change
notes.content: Create branch task/<id>-slug, commit with a Conventional Commits subject naming the task, push, open a PR against main and annotate waiting-for review.

notes.title: Hub topology overview
notes.content: The Mac hub runs the only hub and holds the only memory.db. Every other machine connects as a client over Tailscale.

notes.title: Where docs live
notes.content: Reference docs start at docs/README.md. The tool catalog and tools reference describe every tool, its parameters and limits.

notes.title: Testing guidance
notes.content: Run uv run pytest on the test files you touched. Never run the full suite on the desktop; CI runs it. Lint with ruff check and ruff format.

notes.title: Vault vs repo
notes.content: If it wants a diff it goes in a repo; if it wants a reader it goes in the vault. The Obsidian vault syncs through Obsidian Sync.

notes.title: Worktree basics
notes.content: Claimed tasks get a worktree under .worktrees/task-<id>. Work there, not in the main checkout, and remove the worktree after merge.

notes.title: Agent identity labels
notes.content: Agents identify as Machine_Harness labels such as Desktop_Agent1 or Laptop_Agent2 and commit with that label as the author.

notes.title: Daily standup template
notes.content: Yesterday, today, blockers. Link the task ids and PRs you touched and any decision notes you saved.

notes.title: Debugging checklist
notes.content: Reproduce first, read the logs, check the config and environment, bisect recent changes, then write a failing test before the fix.
